summary: Start dates for four programmes with an empty launched field. Seychelles investor citizenship: launched 2 Dec 2013 (Citizenship (Amendment) Act 2013, gazette and consolidation), legal basis the 1994 Act's special-circumstances clause (1 Jan 1996, a judgement call). Austria: no launch text exists; legal basis sharpened to 1 July 1966 from the 1965 Act. Cyprus fast-track residence: no founding text found, but official 2011-2013 documents show the investor route existed by Aug 2012 (context events). Eden Island: nothing found.

sources.title: Bundesgesetz vom 15. Juli 1965 über die österreichische Staatsbürgerschaft (Staatsbürgerschaftsgesetz 1965), BGBl. Nr. 250/1965
sources.covers: Full text of the 1965 Citizenship Act as gazetted (68. Stück, 11 Aug 1965): § 10 Abs. 4 (constitutional provision: naturalisation when the federal government confirms extraordinary achievements are in the interest of the Republic) and § 65 (in force 1 July 1966).
sources.notes: Scan of the authentic gazette from RIS; text layer is two-column and interleaves in places, quotes were checked against the raw text order. The title line with the date 15 July 1965 was not read in the text layer; only the issue date (11 Aug 1965) is used.

sources.notes: Scan of the gazette supplement, hosted by the Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative (an NGO), not by the government; the SeyLII copy refused automated access (403). OCR has errors (e.g. 'Act Jl of 2013' for Act 11, '5c' for 5C, 'II years' for 11). The Act has no commencement section; only the short title in s. 1.

events.title: Citizenship Act 1965 in force, with the constitutional clause on naturalisation in the interest of the Republic (§ 10 Abs. 4)
events.description: The 1965 Citizenship Act (BGBl. 250/1965, issued 11 Aug 1965) lets the government waive residence and renunciation requirements when it confirms that a person's extraordinary achievements, 'in particular' in science, the economy or the arts, are in the interest of the Republic. § 65(1) puts the Act in force on 1 July 1966; this in-force date is used. It is a general special-interest clause, so under METHODOLOGY decision 14 it is the legal basis, not a launch. It already names economic achievements in 1965, so the existing 1973 event (e-838a28bc20, 'names economic achievements') is worth re-checking: the 1973 change may only have added sport.
events.location: PDF p. 2 (gazette p. 1172), § 10 Abs. 4; PDF p. 11 (gazette p. 1181), § 65 Abs. 1
events.quote: (4) (Verfassungsbestimmung) Die Voraussetzungen des Abs. 1 Z. 1 und 7 sowie des Abs. 2 entfallen, wenn die Bundesregierung bestätigt, daß die Verleihung der Staatsbürgerschaft wegen der vom Fremden bereits erbrachten oder von ihm noch zu erwartenden außerordentlichen Leistungen im Interesse der Republik liegt. ... § 65. (1) Dieses Bundesgesetz tritt am 1. Juli 1966 in Kraft.

events.title: Citizenship (Amendment) Act 2013 published: new s. 5C 'Citizenship to an investor'
events.description: Act 11 of 2013 inserts s. 5C: a person who has invested the rupee equivalent of USD 1,000,000 or more in a Seychelles business and supported themselves during 11 years of residence may be registered as a citizen (plus the language test and no-conviction conditions). Published in the Supplement to the Official Gazette of 2 December 2013; assented 22 Nov 2013; passed 12 Nov 2013. The Act itself states no commencement date, so this is the publication date; the consolidated text (separate event) gives the same date as the effective date. Quote: OCR in the scan reads 'Sc.' for the section number; the wording is otherwise as printed.
events.location: Gazette pp. 477 (header, assent) and 480-481, new s. 5C
events.quote: [2nd December 2013] Supplement to Official Gazette ... A person who has invested Seychelles rupees equivalent to 1,000,000 United States dollars or more in a business in Seychelles

events.title: Investor citizenship section 5C in effect from 2 December 2013 (consolidated Citizenship Act)
events.description: The consolidated Citizenship Act (Cap 30, to 6 Jan 2014) notes that s. 5C was inserted by Act 11 of 2013 with effect from 2 December 2013. This is the in-force date the launch uses; it matches the gazette publication date. Consolidated text, not authentic.
events.location: PDF p. 5, s. 5C and editorial note below it
events.quote: Section inserted by Act 11 of 2013 with effect from 2 December 2013

events.title: Citizenship Act 1994 (in force 1 Jan 1996): President may register a person where 'special circumstances' exist (s. 5(2))
events.description: Before 2013, s. 5(2) let the President register as a citizen anyone for whom special circumstances, in his opinion, warranted it: a general discretionary clause, recorded as legal basis by analogy with Austria and North Macedonia (decision 14). The date is the date printed under the Act's title in the consolidation, read as its commencement date; the consolidation shows no amendment note on s. 5(2), so the wording is taken to be original. Judgement call: s. 5C stands on its own and does not refer to s. 5(2), so a reviewer may prefer to leave legal_basis empty.
events.location: PDF p. 1 header (Act 18 of 1994); PDF p. 4, s. 5(2)
events.quote: [1st January 1996] ... (2) The President may cause to be registered as a citizen any person, not otherwise entitled to or eligible for citizenship, with respect of whom special circumstances exist which, in the opinion of the President, warrant such registration.

events.title: By November 2011: buyers of a home worth at least EUR 300,000 get priority for immigration permits (Ministry decision ratified by Cabinet)
events.description: NOT a launch date. A Civil Registry and Migration Department note (file created 21 Nov 2011) says that under a Ministry of Interior decision ratified by the Council of Ministers, applications from people who bought a home of at least EUR 300,000 are treated favourably, i.e. examined first. The decision's own date is not given. This is the earliest official trace found of an investment-linked route; whether it counts as the start of the programme (it is priority within the ordinary categories, not yet the Regulation 6(2) fast track) is for a reviewer. Category 'context' rather than launch for that reason.
events.location: p. 2, paragraph after the list of documents
events.quote: Σύμφωνα με απόφαση του Υπουργείου Εσωτερικών, η οποία επικυρώθηκε από το Υπουργικό Συμβούλιο, οι αιτήσεις ατόμων που έχουν αποκτήσει με αγορά ιδιόκτητη κατοικία για ιδιοκατοίκηση αξίας όχι χαμηλότερης από €300,000 τυγχάνουν ευνοϊκής μεταχείρισης

events.title: By August 2012: Regulation 6(2) immigration permit for buyers of EUR 300,000 property (official checklist)
events.description: NOT a launch date. The department's checklist for a Regulation 6(2) immigration permit (file created 27 Aug 2012, archived 4 Oct 2012) asks for property of at least EUR 300,000 with at least EUR 200,000 paid, a EUR 30,000 deposit and EUR 30,000 annual income. It shows the investor route under 6(2) existed by then, earlier than the Commission's '2016' and consistent with Transparency International's '2012'.
events.quote: Title of ownership or contract of sale of a built property in Cyprus of a minimum market value of €300.000

events.title: Ministry: 'new fast procedure' applications filed before the March 2013 bank measures will be decided on the old facts
events.description: NOT a launch date. The Ministry of Interior's announcement refers to the 'new fast procedure' for immigration permits and to an 'announced policy' that applicants trusted, so the fast track existed before 15 March 2013. It does not say when it started.

gaps: aut-special-interest: no separate launch text exists. § 10 Abs. 6 StbG 1985 (and its 1965 predecessor § 10 Abs. 4) is a general special-interest clause covering scientists, artists, athletes and business people alike; BGBl. II 39/2014 only sets the procedure. launched stays empty (decision 14). legal_basis is proposed as 1966-07-01 (the 1965 Act's in-force date) in place of the year '1965', which was the year of the Act, not when it came into force. Whether the 1949 Citizenship Act (BGBl. 276/1949) had a similar clause was not checked; the ministry (8483/AB) says the provision exists 'since the Citizenship Act 1965'.

aut-special-interest: the 1965 text already names 'wirtschaftlichen' (economic) achievements, so the existing 1973 event e-838a28bc20 ('Constitutional provision names economic achievements') may overstate what the 1973 amendment changed (it may only have added 'sportlichen'). The 1973 BGBl. 394/1973 was not read.

cyp-golden-visa: no founding text and no start date found. The Ministry/Cabinet decision that created the Regulation 6(2) fast track for investors was not found in any official source; the 2023 criteria call themselves the 'fourth revision' (2 May 2023) but the earlier versions were not found. Official evidence found shows the route existed by Aug 2012 (6(2) checklist) and that a priority rule for EUR 300,000 home buyers existed by Nov 2011 (decision undated), recorded as context events. launched left empty. Sources now on record disagree: TI 2018 says 2012, the Commission 2019 says 2016; the 2012 checklist shows 2016 is too late for the start.

cyp-golden-visa: the Audit Office's 2023 special report on the 'Golden Visa' (which may describe the scheme's history and decisions) was not found: not in the Wayback index of audit.gov.cy PDFs for 2023-2024, and the Migration Department site (gov.cy/mip-md) refuses automated access (Azure WAF 403).

syc-investor-citizenship: the Act itself has no commencement clause; the in-force date 2 Dec 2013 comes from the consolidation's editorial notes (not authentic) and matches the gazette date. The SeyLII record (said to give commencement 2 Dec 2013 and assent 22 Nov 2013) could not be read (403). Whether s. 5C was later repealed (a 2022-2023 amendment bill reportedly abolished the 2013 special criteria for investors) was not checked; status 'active' may be wrong.

syc-eden-island-residence: no start date, founding text or legal basis found. Official mentions found: the Immigration Department fee list (2020, already stored) and the November 2013 Quick Guide (already stored), whose worked example says a USD 1.5 million villa on Eden Island 'only gives her eligibility for a Residence Permit', i.e. the property route existed by Nov 2013 without saying when it began or on what basis. Industry FAQs (Pam Golding) now return 404. The Immigration Regulations' fee schedule amendments and any Eden Island development agreement were not obtained.

Not extracted, outside this brief: cyp-crmd-immigration-permits-info-2011 gives counts of all immigration-permit applications and grants (2009: 283 / 205; 2010: 312 / 212; to Oct 2011: 422 / 248). These cover every category, not investors, so they were not recorded as observations; the 2012 checklist gives pre-2021 terms (EUR 300,000 property, EUR 30,000 deposit, EUR 30,000 income + EUR 5,000 per dependant) that could fill the 'pre-2021 terms not verified' gap in program_terms.
